Pressure Steam Quirk.name: Pressure Steam Quirk
Pressure Steam Quirk.description:
♨️ Water heated inside your body vents as pressurized steam.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Water and Fire: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you spray a short stream of hot water to douse flames and vent a scalding puff of vapor at close range.
📈 With training: steam-piston strikes and jumps, a scalding fog held back to warm mist for cover, a pressure valve that bursts a door or lifts rubble, a boiling water slug and a hall filled with humid heat.
⚠️ Steam must vent through your skin, so tight wraps block it, and dry air and cold rooms limit your output.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as unvented steam cooks your own core.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Conditioning +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Warm Spray, Scald Puff
🛡️ Resists: fire
Pressure Steam Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the body makes and heats water, venting hot water, mist or steam from palms, forearms, calves. New adult user: a hot spray about 5 m (douses small fires, shoves adults back), a 2 m scalding puff, or a doorway of mist in seconds. Limits: heated water must be vented, and blocked pores or tight wraps stop it. Dry, cold air halves reach and condenses steam harmlessly within a stride or two. Quirk Strain: light: warm spray, short puff; moderate: floor flush, wet-heat sear, piston strike or jump, fog screen, pressure release; heavy: boiling slug; severe: signature blowout, heating a hall. Fusion: Water's water + Fire's heat; half a Water user's volume and range, no open flames (heat stays inside); only it makes high-pressure steam. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed scalding is assault; crowded high-pressure venting is public endangerment. Look: white plumes at wrists, elbows, ankles.
